Aur jab darya beh kar ek doosre se mil jaayenge
Aur jab qabron ko ubhaar diya jaaega
Tab har nafs ko maaloom hoga ke kya muqaddam kiya hai aur kya mu'akhkhar kiya hai
Aye insaan! Tujhe Rab-e-Kareem ke baare mein kis shai ne dhoke mein rakha hai
Us ne tujhe paida kiya hai aur phir baraabar kar ke mutawaazin banaaya hai
Us ne jis soorat mein chaaha hai tere ajza ki tarkeeb ki hai
Magar tum log jaza ka inkaar karte ho
Aur yaqeenan tumhaare saron par nigehbaan muqarrar hain
Woh tumhaare aamaal ko khoob jaante hain
Beshak nek log ne'maton mein honge
Aur badkaar afraad Jahannam mein honge
Woh roz-e-jaza usi mein jhonk diye jaayenge
Aur woh us se bach kar na ja sakenge
Aur tum kya jaano ke jaza ka din kya shai hai
Phir tumhein kya maaloom ke jaza ka din kaisa hota hai
Us din koi kisi ke baare mein koi ikhtiyaar na rakhta hoga aur saara ikhtiyaar Allah ke haathon mein hoga
